title: Performance FX (prototype)
description: Prototype: double-tap TRK to turn the 16 trig keys into hold-to-apply performance effects (octave and fifth jumps, tape stop, dive, rise, mutes), FUNC to latch, two banks, per-track include, colored trig LEDs. NO closes it. Needs a core with ST_NATIVE_PITCH (host API 21; prototype 2.9.0-mt1). Test build, not for a pull request.
author: Safie Flato (steveflato)
